meta.title: Francisco Piñero Alpañés
meta.description: Francisco Piñero Alpañés. Digital transformation, interfaces, and applied AI. Based in Alicante.

identity.lead: I ship AI solutions that make daily work clearer to use. I want a similar role: more weight on interface and UX, room to experiment, and a team with a strong technical base.
identity.place: Alicante. Remote, or hybrid if the team is here.

trajectory.title: Path
trajectory.lead: Three stretches of the same career. Not a change of trade: a change of scale.

consultora.heading: Web development in a small shop
consultora.body: Five years of real product: management apps, e-commerce, admin UI. Laravel, Vue, Docker, databases. Alongside that, a BSc in Computer Engineering (University of Alicante, Software Engineering) and Coffizine, the final project: web forms generated with the people who use them.

transformacion.heading: Digital transformation, with AI in the middle
transformacion.body: I moved to shipping generative-AI solutions — conversational assistance, automation — and building the internal tools and frontends that make them usable. Azure, Docker, CI/CD, APIs. The work was mostly remote; I was already in Alicante.

ahora.heading: The same problem, closer to the interface
ahora.body: I still want to change operations with software and AI. What I want more of: designing how it is used, room to try things, and an established team to argue the craft with.

work.title: Work
work.lead: What changed for the people who used it. Public version: no clients, internal products, or detail that does not belong here.

ai.title: Support that asks, instead of hunting
ai.body: Operations stopped jumping between tickets, wikis, and email. Conversational assistance over their own documentation: an interface to resolve work, not a generic chat.

vision.title: The first field review is done by the system
vision.body: When photographic evidence is required, the system says whether the capture is good enough and why. A person steps in when it fails.

queues.title: From a massive list to the next action
queues.body: Operations stopped deciding case by case on huge queues. An interface applies rules and suggests what to do; human review is left for what does not fit.

delivery.title: Internal products do not invent the path every time
delivery.body: Specify, implement, and ship to the cloud with the same interface standard. The value is team speed, not a one-off repository.

coffizine.title: Coffizine
coffizine.body: Final degree project: interactive generation of web forms. The hook is UX; it is not a product in production.

skills.title: Craft
skills.lead: A wide technical base. The current bias is interface.
skills.also: Also Vue, APIs, CI/CD, and ways of working with applied AI.
